name: Palmiers
summary: Puff pastry rolled in sugar, folded, sliced, caramelised flat.

steps.text: Laminate a rough puff, using sugar instead of flour to roll.
Fold both sides to the centre twice and chill firm.
Slice 1 cm thick and lay flat with space to spread.
Flip halfway through the bake to caramelise both sides.

bake.notes: They will spread to twice the width. Space generously.

notes: Flipping is essential for even caramelisation.
